title: A Sequential Approach to Mild Distributions
summary: We describe an elementary sequential realization of the Banach Gelfand triple (S0(R^d), L2(R^d), S0'(R^d)). Here S0(R^d) is a Segal algebra of test functions, L2(R^d) is the usual Hilbert space, and S0'(R^d) is its dual space of mild distributions. This framework is fundamental for Gabor analysis and provides a natural setting for the generalized Fourier transform and the short-time Fourier transform.
